nodes.label: OSC Engineering Handbook
nodes.rationale: The standards this repository is held to. Frames contributors as building a production system that must remain understandable for years, so every technical decision should favour long-term quality over short-term convenience.

nodes.label: Engineering Optimisation Priority Order
nodes.rationale: Correctness > reliability > maintainability > readability > scalability > performance > development speed, in that order. Never sacrifice correctness for convenience; avoid premature optimisation. This ordering is what the status document cites when defending decisions like abstention-as-architecture and hybrid retrieval.

nodes.label: Avoid Unnecessary Abstractions
nodes.rationale: Explicit prohibition on duplicated logic, dead code, unnecessary abstractions, overengineering, magic numbers and hidden side effects. Prefer composition over unnecessary inheritance; prefer the simpler solution when it achieves the same goal without sacrificing extensibility. Every abstraction must solve a real engineering problem.

nodes.label: Documentation as a First-Class Deliverable
nodes.rationale: Comments should explain why something exists, architectural intent, business rules, assumptions and edge cases — not restate the code. Documentation must explain what was built, why, and how it works, assuming future developers know nothing about today's decisions. This is why PROJECT_STATUS.md and the profile YAML files carry rationale inline.

nodes.label: Session Startup Protocol
nodes.rationale: Before implementing any feature: read PROJECT_STATUS.md, then README.md, then graphify-out/wiki/, understand the current milestone, and confirm the implementation plan before modifying code. This is the mechanism that makes the knowledge graph and status document load-bearing rather than decorative.

nodes.label: Testing Increases Confidence, Not Coverage
nodes.rationale: Prefer unit tests, edge-case testing, failure-path testing and deterministic tests. Testing should increase confidence rather than simply improve coverage — which is the standard the status document measures itself against when noting that three tests are regressions for reproduced defects and that the seams are proven against stubs more than real providers.

edges.source_location: Documentation must explain what/why/how; PROJECT_STATUS.md §12 exists to satisfy this
